caption: The drawing features two main objects on a light beige background. In the lower center, there is a dark brown fireman's hat with a wide, slightly curved brim. The front of the hat displays a colorful emblem consisting of a shield with a gold border and the number "4" in the center, also in gold. Surrounding the shield is the text "FRANKLIN FIRE CO." in gold letters, set against a red background. Behind the shield, two American flags are draped outward, showing red, white, and blue stripes. In the upper right section of the drawing, there is a red ribbon banner that loops and winds around a large gold numeral "4." The ribbon is inscribed with the words "HASTE TO THE RESCUE" in gold letters, spread across three segments of the ribbon. The overall color palette features shades of browns, golds, reds, blues, and whites.
title: Fireman's Hat
